sentences.text: The discovered specimen features a relatively well-preserved diapsid skull, a type of skull structure with two temporal openings, that resembles that of Confuciusornis.
Its dentition is unique among Enantiornithes, a group of feathered dinosaurs known for their bird-like characteristics.
The genus Shenqiornis was named and described in 2010 by a research team including Wang Xuri, Jingmai O'Connor, and Luis María Chiappe.
Shenqiornis is classified as a genus of enantiornithean dinosaurs.
It belongs to the family Bohaiornithidae.
Shenqiornis fossils were found in the Qiaotou Member of the Huajiying Formation in Hebei Province, China, where their exact age remains uncertain.
Based on correlations with the Yixian Formation, the animal is probably dated to the Aptian stage, around 122 million years ago.
